posts.title: Take-Two Estimates GTA VI Hit $3.79 Billion in Day-One Retail Sales
posts.description: Take-Two's first official numbers for Grand Theft Auto VI put day-one retail spending at $3.79 billion, alongside 32.5 million units sold before release. The figure sits far above outside estimates, but it measures what buyers spent at retail, not what the publisher keeps. posts.title: Hellraiser: Revival Takes Horror Game of the Year as Resident Evil Requiem Wins the Most Awards
posts.description: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival beat Resident Evil Requiem for Game of the Year at the fifth Horror Game Awards in London. Requiem still won more awards than any other game, while nomination leader REANIMAL left with little to show for its 10 nods. posts.title: Ubisoft cuts 166 jobs at Assassin’s Creed studios in Quebec as half-year loss widens
posts.description: Ubisoft is laying off 166 staff in Montréal and Québec City, including people at its Tencent-backed Vantage Studios. The cuts landed on the same day as half-year results showing a deeper loss and a shrinking workforce.
